title: Nonempty coefficient open avoiding zero at every prescribed jet
statement: Let $k$ be algebraically closed and $X$ a smooth finite-type $k$-scheme of pure dimension $d\geq 2$ [def-weil-pure-dimension]. Let $S$ be a finite set of closed points. Let $f:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ and $j:X\to Y$ with $f\circ j$ the structure morphism. Let $M$ be invertible on $Y$ with invertible tensor pullback to $X$. For a finite family $s=(s_i)_{i\in I}$ use the coefficient combinations, jets and coefficient points of [def-zl-prescribed-point-system-data]. Assume every coefficient combination pulls back to a section vanishing on $S$, and the simultaneous map $k^I\to\prod_{x\in S}\operatorname{PrescribedPointJet}(j^*M,x)$ is surjective. There is a nonempty Zariski open $W\subseteq\operatorname{Spec}k[t_i\mid i\in I]$ such that every $k$-valued coefficient point landing in $W$ has nonzero jet at each $x\in S$. The set $S$ may be empty. This asserts no smoothness of the zero schemes and requires no generation or immersion on the complement.

proof.text: Finite type over the field makes X locally Noetherian. If the stalk at a closed x were a field, the stalk dimension/coheight equality of [lem-sc-scheme-stalk-dimension-generalization-chains] would give coheight zero. Thus x has no proper generalization and is generic for an irreducible component. Since x is closed, this component is its singleton, of dimension zero, contradicting positive pure dimension [def-weil-pure-dimension]. Mathlib IsLocalRing.subsingleton_cotangentSpace_iff now gives a nonzero cotangent space. The stalk frame of [lem-weil-pbc-invertible-stalk-linear-equiv], tensor congruence and TensorProduct.rid identify the jet target of [def-zl-prescribed-point-system-data] with this nonzero space. This argument uses only positive pure dimension and local Noetherianity, not smoothness or a differential dimension calculation.

For each x form the scalar ring map k to the stalk by composing the map to global sections on Y, pullback along j, and the germ map. The canonical tensor-section unit is semilinear, as follows directly from its module-morphism unit and restriction definition. The framed germ of a coefficient combination is additive and semilinear for this ring map. Vanishing puts it in the maximal ideal: apply the frame to the ideal multiple of the stalk module and use m times R equals m. Map these coefficients through m to m/m^2 and tensor with the frame vector. These linear maps give a k-linear coefficient-to-jet map equal to the concrete prescribedPointJet, including the proof-dependent branch in its definition.

Choose a nonzero vector b_x in each jet target, and use simultaneous surjectivity to lift the tuple to a coefficient a_0. Mathlib Module.Projective.exists_dual_ne_zero over a field gives a k-linear functional detecting b_x. Its composite F_x with the coefficient map is represented by the linear polynomial sum_i C(F_x(single_i(1))) X_i; expansion of a coefficient tuple in the standard basis proves evaluation equals F_x(a). Intersect the finitely many basic opens of these polynomials. The point associated to a_0 lies in each, proving nonemptiness. At any coefficient point in the intersection each F_x(a) is nonzero, hence the jet is nonzero. Empty S gives the empty intersection, the whole coefficient spectrum. This construction does not require finite-dimensional jet targets or identification of their residue fields with k.

proof_origin.place: Paragraph 2, nonzero first derivative is a nonempty open condition; J3 supplies a direct proof via the cotangent field criterion and detecting linear functionals, avoiding differential dimension comparisons.

theorem exists_open_prescribedPoint_nonzeroJets
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [Smooth (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hdim : X.IsPureDimension d)
    (S : Finset X) (hclosed : ∀ x ∈ S, IsClosed ({x} : Set X))
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (j : X ⟶ Y)
    (hover : j ≫ f = X ↘ Spec (.of k))
    (M : Y.Modules) [M.IsInvertible] [((tensorPullback j).obj M).IsInvertible]
    {I : Type u} [Fintype I] (s : I → Γ(M, ⊤))
    (hvan : ∀ a : I → k, prescribedPointVanishes ((tensorPullback j).obj M) S
      (tensorSectionsUnit j M (prescribedPointCombination f M s a)))
    (hjet : Function.Surjective (fun a : I → k ↦ fun x : S ↦
      prescribedPointJet ((tensorPullback j).obj M) x.val
        (tensorSectionsUnit j M (prescribedPointCombination f M s a)))) :
    ∃ O : (Spec (CommRingCat.of (MvPolynomial I k))).Opens,
      (O : Set (Spec (CommRingCat.of (MvPolynomial I k)))).Nonempty ∧
      ∀ a : I → k, Set.range (bertiniCoefficientPoint (k := k) a) ⊆ (O : Set _) →
        ∀ x ∈ S, prescribedPointJet ((tensorPullback j).obj M) x
          (tensorSectionsUnit j M (prescribedPointCombination f M s a)) ≠ 0
